# MCP tools: Trash and activity

<!-- Generated by `sidekick.mcp.export_tool_reference` from `contracts/mcp-tools.generated.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

[MCP tool reference](index.md) | 4 model-visible tools. The tools of this area that only the MCP App rooms call are on the [app-only page](app-only.md).

## `list_trash`

Use this to see the authenticated user's recoverable trash, newest first, optionally narrowed to one record kind.

Access: read

Scopes: requires at least one of `contacts:read`, `journal:read`, `projects:read`, `shopping:read`, `tasks:read`.

Returns: `TrashListResult` with `items` (array of TrashItemRecord), `has_more` (boolean), `next_cursor` (string or null).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cursor` | string | no | up to 2048 characters; may be null |
| `kind` | string | no | one of `domain`, `process`, `project`, `task`, `step`, `action`, `contact`, `journal_entry`, `shopping_item`; may be null |
| `limit` | integer | no | default `100`; 1 to 100 |

## `move_to_trash`

Use this only after asking the user and getting an explicit yes in this turn to move this record to the trash.

Access: write (destructive)

Scopes: requires at least one of `contacts:write`, `journal:write`, `projects:write`, `shopping:write`, `tasks:write`.

Returns: `TrashItemRecord` with `id` (uuid), `kind` (string), `label` (string or null), `trashed_at` (date-time or null), `version` (integer).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `idempotency_key` | string | yes | 8 to 128 characters |
| `kind` | string | yes | one of `domain`, `process`, `project`, `task`, `step`, `action`, `contact`, `journal_entry`, `shopping_item` |
| `record_id` | uuid | yes | - |
| `version` | integer | yes | at least 1 |

## `restore_from_trash`

Use this when the user wants something back from the trash.

Access: write

Scopes: requires at least one of `contacts:write`, `journal:write`, `projects:write`, `shopping:write`, `tasks:write`.

Returns: `TrashItemRecord` with `id` (uuid), `kind` (string), `label` (string or null), `trashed_at` (date-time or null), `version` (integer).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `idempotency_key` | string | yes | 8 to 128 characters |
| `kind` | string | yes | one of `domain`, `process`, `project`, `task`, `step`, `action`, `contact`, `journal_entry`, `shopping_item` |
| `record_id` | uuid | yes | - |
| `version` | integer | yes | at least 1 |

## `list_assistant_activity`

Use this for a bounded, newest-first page of the authenticated user's own Activity Center entries: what changed, by whom, and in which state.

Access: read

Scopes: requires `tasks:read`.

Returns: `ActivityPageResult` with `items` (array of ActivityRecord), `next_cursor` (string or null).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `category` | string | no | up to 48 characters; may be null |
| `cursor` | string | no | up to 2048 characters; may be null |
| `include_content` | boolean | no | default `true` |
| `limit` | integer | no | default `25`; 1 to 100 |
| `state` | string | no | one of `applied`, `review`, `failed`, `reverted`; may be null |
